description: WRITE. Delete YOUR man-hours (工数) for one date (YYYY-MM-DD, Japan time) and projectId. If taskId is omitted, ALL tasks of that project on that day are deleted — confirm that explicitly with the user. Idempotent: deleting what is already gone returns deleted:false and changes nothing. Closed (締め) or fixed (確定) days cannot be changed; do not retry. If this tool is not listed, the server is read-only (KINTAI_PLUS_READ_ONLY).

confirm.description: Set true to apply this write when the client cannot show a confirmation dialog. If confirmation is required and this is omitted, the tool returns a preview and changes nothing. Ignored when this call does not require confirmation.

projectId.description: Project whose man-hours to delete. From get_manhours or get_my_projects.

taskId.description: One task to delete. Omit only when the user wants every task of this project on that day removed.

name: delete_manhours
title: Delete my man-hours
